resources.string: Anyone can inspect the source code. Open source does not mean the app has been independently audited.

Screen-content retrieval is disabled. The service declares

canRetrieveWindowContent="false"

and is not granted that capability.

App detection uses only package and class metadata from window changes. Screen text, routes and locations are not read. No app history is stored or transmitted. No location or internet permission is requested.
Blocking is best-effort. System controls, emergency screens and notifications may remain available.
